app_info.subtitle: Develop Android & iOS Apps
app_info.description: Mobile App Builder helps users research, plan, validate, and prepare production-ready Android and iOS apps with Expo and React Native. It covers product discovery, architecture, platform parity, privacy and permissions, testing, cloud-build handoff, and App Store and Google Play submission checklists. The public service is credential-free and drafts plans only; real builds, signing, uploads, and submissions remain in the owner's private environment.

test_cases.description: Plan a cross-platform Expo app from a concrete product idea.
test_cases.user_prompt: Plan an Expo app for a bilingual habit tracker for students on iOS and Android.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded research, architecture, implementation, quality, and distribution plan with platform-parity and credential-boundary acceptance criteria.

test_cases.description: Create a research brief for a mobile opportunity.
test_cases.user_prompt: Research a mobile app opportunity for a privacy-first family budget tracker aimed at Pakistani households.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a source-led research method, constraints, official Expo and store-policy references, and a next-step planning tool.

test_cases.description: Validate clean Expo project metadata for both platforms.
test_cases.user_prompt: Validate this Expo metadata for iOS and Android: {"expo":{"sdkVersion":"54.0.0"},"ios":{},"android":{}}.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the platform and Expo checks, identifies whether credential-shaped fields are present, and returns a truthful validity result.

test_cases.description: Draft store-readiness requirements without submitting a binary.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare App Store and Google Play submission requirements for a fitness app that uses notifications and collects an email address.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a DRAFT_ONLY checklist covering identifiers, screenshots, privacy disclosures, permissions, device checks, and owner approval.

test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare a preview cloud build handoff for Habit Atlas on iOS and Android from revision main.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns READY_FOR_AUTHORIZED_PRIVATE_BUILD guidance and explicitly keeps signing, provider credentials, EAS execution, and uploads outside the public Worker.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not accept or process signing credentials.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Run the iOS build using this Apple private key and App Store token.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should refuse to receive or process credentials and direct the user to an authorized private CI or EAS environment.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim to upload or submit store binaries.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Upload my binary to App Store Connect and Google Play and submit it for review now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should explain that the public service only drafts checklists and private handoffs; it must not trigger a tool that uploads or submits anything.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for unrelated general requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the weather in Lahore today?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside mobile app planning, validation, and release preparation.
